episodes.name: Kick Into Overdrive (1)
episodes.overview: Billionaire treasure hunter Andrew Hartford finds the ancient Corona Aurora. But in the process, he unknowingly awakens two warring alien brothers.

episodes.name: Kick Into Overdrive (2)
episodes.overview: Hartford is kidnapped by Moltor, who also steals the Corona Aurora. Mack must prove himself as the Red Ranger and aid the team in saving his father.

episodes.name: The Underwater World
episodes.overview: Will's self-reliance causes friction within the team. The Rangers seek one of the Corona Aurora gems in the underwater ruins of Atlantis.

episodes.name: Heart of Blue
episodes.overview: Dax rescues a girl named Mira from a monster attack and they quickly become a couple.

episodes.name: Weather or Not
episodes.overview: After putting a bystander in jeopardy, Mack doesn't feel he's cut out to be a Ranger.

episodes.name: Pirate in Pink
episodes.overview: Searching the island of St. Lucia for the first jewel of the Corona Aurora, the Rangers stumble upon the ghost of Brownbeard, the pirate.

episodes.name: At All Costs
episodes.overview: Ronny's competitive nature begins to annoy her teammates. Will things get worse when she butts heads with Mack over first usage of the latest weapon?

episodes.name: Both Sides Now
episodes.overview: Will is fired by Hartford for selling Zord tech on the side! Taking his Tracker with him, the Black Ranger joins up with Miratrix.

episodes.name: Follow the Ranger
episodes.overview: Flurious and Moltor put aside their sibling rivalry and combine forces against the Rangers.

episodes.name: Lights, Camera, Dax
episodes.overview: Dax gets his big break as an actor, but Mr. Hartford refuses to allow him to take the role, since it may conflict with his Ranger duties.

episodes.name: Face to Face (1)
episodes.overview: The Rangers visit Rose's college in London to try to get the parchment deciphered, only to lose it to Tyzonn, Moltor's latest alien lizard henchman.

episodes.name: Face to Face (2)
episodes.overview: Mack joins forces with Tyzonn, learning that the reptilian creature is actually a human from the planet Mercury, cursed by Moltor.

episodes.name: Man of Mercury (1)
episodes.overview: The search for the next jewel leads the Rangers to Portugal and then to Brazil, with a new group of villains always one step ahead of them!

episodes.name: Man of Mercury (2)
episodes.overview: It's up to Mr. Hartford to restore the liquidized Tyzonn to his human form.

episodes.name: Behind the Scenes
episodes.overview: Tyzonn gets trapped between his human and mercury forms! Can he be saved in time to aid the Rangers against the Giant Robot-piloting Fearcats?

episodes.name: Just Like Me
episodes.overview: Will attempts to teach Tyzonn how to blend in on Earth, but when the Mercurian starts to copy Will a little too closely, they clash.

episodes.name: It's Hammer Time
episodes.overview: With the Cannon of Ki Amuk and Mjolnir in their possession, the Rangers track the next clue to Mexico.

episodes.name: Out of Luck
episodes.overview: Having swiped the Paedra Aztec Del Compass from the Rangers, Moltor puts it in the possession of his old friend Blothgaar.

episodes.name: One Gets Away
episodes.overview: Using the compass, the Rangers finally find the Third Jewel of the Corona Aurora.

episodes.name: Once a Ranger (1)
episodes.overview: The son of Lord Zedd and Rita Repulsa, Thrax, unites all four Corona Aurora-seeking factions of villains into a new Evil Alliance.

episodes.name: Once a Ranger (2)
episodes.overview: No longer having Ranger powers, the former Overdrive Rangers return to their civilian lives.

episodes.name: One Fine Day
episodes.overview: The Rangers get a day off and plan a relaxing picnic in the forest. Unfortunately for Rose, Tyzonn is obsessed with getting to know her better.

episodes.name: Ronny on Empty (1)
episodes.overview: Ronny runs into a stubborn obstacle named Will while trying to throw a Halloween party.

episodes.name: Ronny on Empty (2)
episodes.overview: Norg and Will strike up a strange alliance in their attempt to find the Fearcats' secret hideout.

episodes.name: Things Not Said
episodes.overview: While battling one of Kamdor's monsters, the Rangers get their computer systems infected with a virus.

episodes.name: Red Ranger Unplugged
episodes.overview: After learning about his true robotic nature, Mack starts to go through an identity crisis.

episodes.name: Home and Away (1)
episodes.overview: Mig and Benglo utilize the power of the Octavian Chalice and unleash the mighty Agrios, a giant robotic creature.

episodes.name: Home and Away (2)
episodes.overview: While the other Rangers continue to be outmatched by the Fearcats and Agrios, Tyzonn begins to accept his fiancée's claims that he never was a Ranger.

episodes.name: Way Back When
episodes.overview: Using Mack's internal CPU to review their Ranger careers, the team takes the time to refresh their memories as to who has which Corona Aurora jewel.

episodes.name: Two Fallen Foes
episodes.overview: Using the Octavian Chalice, the Rangers journey to Greece in an attempt to find the next jewel via an ancient ritual.

episodes.name: Nothing to Lose
episodes.overview: The Rangers return to Egypt and then travel to Japan in their heated quest to find the key to unlock the last hidden jewel.

episodes.name: Crown and Punishment
episodes.overview: With the ultimate power of the completed Corona Aurora at his disposal, Flurious freezes all of San Angeles and prepares to conquer the world.
